headline: World Series Game 4: Brewers @ Rays, 5:00 PM PT on FOX. Milwaukee leads 3-0 and can sweep for its first title. Plus an 11-game NHL card. WNBA Finals Game 6 is Thursday (Valkyries lead 3-2).

record.label: Yesterday (Mon 10/26)
record.note: Milwaukee blew out the Rays 10-1 and chased Peralta in the 5th, so the Rays ML, Peralta outs and the SGP all lost. The WNBA Finals Under hit (64-55), and the Cowboys covered (38-21). Reese had 5 assists (lost). The Lamb yards and Howard threes props couldn't be confirmed.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Monday these went 1-2. Today: the Brewers going for the sweep, plus two NHL sides where SI and SportsBettingDime agree.

straight.reasoning: TheLines and Yahoo both pick Milwaukee. The Brewers are 9-1 this postseason and have won seven straight. Their bullpen has a 1.34 ERA over nearly 54 playoff innings and should be fully rested for a bullpen game. Tampa starts Griffin Jax, who allowed three runs in four innings last time out. Playable to -145.

SI and SportsBettingDime both pick Florida. Winnipeg has lost five straight, scored six goals in its last four, and is in a letdown spot after Sunday's outdoor Heritage Classic. Florida outshot Chicago 34-21 in its last win. Playable to -145.

SI and SportsBettingDime both pick Dallas. The Stars have won five straight, and Jason Robertson has eight points in a four-game streak. New Jersey may debut Connor Hellebuyck, who hasn't played in months. Playable to -135.

parlay.title: Two-Source Favorites
parlay.reasoning: The two hockey sides where both sources agree. Both start at 5:00 PM PT. Pays about 2.4-to-1.

props.pick: William Contreras OVER 1.5 hits + runs + RBIs
props.reasoning: He's 18-for-43 (.419) with three homers this postseason, has cleared this line in four straight games, and is 2-for-3 against Jax. SI's best prop, and TheLines also likes his total bases. Playable to -120.
